rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: All three angles are cos formulas on direction data — lines: cos θ = |b1·b2|/(|b1||b2|); planes: cos θ = |n1·n2|/(|n1||n2|); line-plane: sin θ = |b·n|/(|b||n|).  ·  Trick 2: Perpendicular/parallel tests: lines ⊥ ⇔ b1·b2 = 0; planes ∥ ⇔ n1 = λn2; line ∥ plane ⇔ b·n = 0 — the dot-product zero is the fastest test.
